design.question: Do bounded provenance-aware revised beliefs improve executed utility under a fixed selector?
design.primary_contrast: mind minus structured, paired terminal coin-equivalent utility; each seed averaged across six families
design.primary_endpoint: Actor cash change plus declared value of actually delivered goods; credit/report payments are actual funded transfers. All verification/booking costs included.
secondary: stale/unknown belief relative to admitted evidence
design.information: Identical scoped structured+text observation tapes and public goal/action terms for all deployable arms. No world-state or future-outcome input. Purchased verification is a real costly endogenous observation, separately recorded.
design.planner: Same AgentMind.choose and common options_from_view for every arm; only memory retention/retrieval/belief maintenance varies. Utilities and resource/deadline checks fixed.
design.budgets: One complete memory record cap across episodic/semantic/social/revision/reflection. Own-goal/last-decision state separately bounded; serialized bytes measured. Semantic records can be smaller; equal slots are not equal bytes. No archive retrieval.
design.baselines: FIFO and BM25 retain at most12 episodes. Bounded structured/guarded adapters rebuild original algorithms only from the shared capped context. Guarded equals structured on this keyed track; its text-only hashed fallback is not a dense baseline.
design.controls: Four balanced seed variants per family: true/false or unchanged/changed reports, shared/independent roots, fulfilled/broken history, interference/no-interference, resource changes and no feasible profitable action. Verification can waste funds; stale high-salience records can mislead.
design.source_lineage: Only communicated origin claims count; no omniscient authentication. False reports can be epistemically supported and unlucky. Roots are not independent merely because relay speakers differ.
design.inference: 2000 percentile paired bootstrap resamples over32 seed means; families reported separately. Other contrasts descriptive, no significance-star selection.
design.failure_policy: Abort on invalid accounting, storage/context/access violations or changed registered source. Preserve raw rows. No heldout tuning; new changes need a new version and unused seeds.
limits: Small authored synthetic economy, not full-game outcome evidence
Structured propositions/terms are shared oracle-format assistance, not language parsing
No live model or human study
Policy utilities and evidence thresholds are authored heuristics, not calibrated expected values
